samples.summary: New admission rule copies lens+file but not `summary`, so a summary-less hand-written rebuttal still adjudicates nothing silently
samples.evidence: `unusableRebuttalReason` (scripts/agent/spec-to-pr.mjs:628-638) admits any record with a non-empty lens and file. But the matcher this rule is justified by needs a third field: `findingSimilarity` (scripts/agent/rounds.mjs:519-533) gates on lens+file and then scores `summary` — with an empty summary the token set degenerates and it falls back to exact text equality against the finding's summary, returning 0, so `matchRebuttal` (scripts/agent/rebuttal.mjs:315-341) never reaches the threshold and the record matches no finding. The cloud channel is protected by its WRITER: `cmdPost` refuses to post without `--summary` (scripts/agent/rebuttal.mjs:563). The local `--rebuttals` file has no writer at all, so this is precisely the channel where a summary-less record arrives — it passes the new validation, is written into the round, counted in `adjudicating N rebuttal(s)` (spec-to-pr.mjs:1153) and adjudicates nothing, which is the exact silent loss this change exists to close. Fix belongs on the new code: extend `unusableRebuttalReason` to require a non-empty `summary` (the field `matchRebuttal` actually scores).

finding.summary: The new local `--rebuttals` path reproduces only ONE of `parseRebuttalComment`'s normalizations, so a hand-written record missing `lens` or `file` is accepted and then silently adjudicates nothing
finding.evidence: `normalizeRebuttals` (scripts/agent/spec-to-pr.mjs, the `.map((r) => ... replace(/^agent-review-/, ""))` helper) only strips the check-run prefix and drops non-objects; `readRebuttalRecords`/`prepareRoundInputs` then write the records straight to the panel's `--rebuttals`. The cloud channel goes through scripts/agent/rebuttal.mjs:203-205, which REFUSES a record whose `lens` or `file` is empty (`if (lens === "" || file === "") return null;`) precisely because "without both, a rebuttal can never match anything". The consumers confirm it: scripts/agent/rounds.mjs:521-522 returns 0 unless `lens` AND `file` compare equal, and scripts/agent/review-panel.mjs:2328-2330 partitions with `(typeof r?.lens === "string" ? r.lens : "") === lensId`, where `lensId: lens.id` (review-panel.mjs:3018) is always non-empty. So a developer following .claude/commands/self-review.md who omits `file` (or spells the path differently from the finding's) gets a run that prints "adjudicating 1 rebuttal(s)" and adjudicates none — the silent-loss failure the docblock above `normalizeRebuttals` calls "the worst failure this path has". Fix belongs on the new code: mirror rebuttal.mjs:203-205's non-empty lens/file rejection, not only its prefix strip.

verdict.reason: The finding claims the local `--rebuttals` path reproduces only the prefix-strip from `parseRebuttalComment` and omits the non-empty lens/file rejection. It does not. `unusableRebuttalReason` at scripts/agent/spec-to-pr.mjs:628-637 is an explicit mirror of rebuttal.mjs:203-205, rejecting non-objects, empty/whitespace/prefix-only `lens`, and empty `file`. `normalizeRebuttals` (spec-to-pr.mjs:662-666) filters on it before mapping, and `readRebuttalRecords` (spec-to-pr.mjs:710-720) escalates further than the cloud channel by THROWING and naming every unusable record by index instead of dropping it silently — so the described failure ("prints 'adjudicating 1 rebuttal(s)' and adjudicates none") cannot happen; the run refuses to start. Both the real run (spec-to-pr.mjs:1149 -> prepareRoundInputs -> readRebuttalRecords) and the dry run (spec-to-pr.mjs:1120-1129) pass through the same validator. Tests pin the behaviour at spec-to-pr.test.mjs:509-525, asserting that records missing `lens`, missing `file`, whitespace-only, or bare `agent-review-` all normalize to []. The fix the finding prescribes is already present at the precise location it names.
